scenes.line1: How do you avoid goroutine chaos?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how to keep goroutines from spiraling out of control? Let's break down the best ways to manage them.

scenes.label: Limit
scenes.sub: Too many goroutines can overload memory and CPU.
scenes.say: First, limit how many goroutines run at once. Launching too many can overload your system and cause performance issues.
Coordinate goroutines with WaitGroups, use context to cancel them cleanly, and always monitor for leaks.
Here's how you use a WaitGroup to make sure every goroutine finishes before moving on.

scenes.question: What happens if you forget to call Done?
scenes.right: WaitGroup never completes, causing deadlocks or leaks.
scenes.say: If you forget to signal completion, your WaitGroup will hang, leading to deadlocks or goroutine leaks. Don't miss this step in interviews.
